title: docs(news): correct the repair guide's send recovery steps
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Corrected the internal news-pipeline repair guide. For a stuck send, check Buffer’s Queue and Sent tabs and the destination before marking it failed; leave an uncertain send at `attempt`. To recover a model post, rerun the failed job from the original run so its `models` artifact records the text sent; a new run produces text the record rejects, and `models` with `write + save` only writes. Clarified that `run=deliver` on `daily` or `weekly` schedules Buffer only, while Reddit and the weekly Discord post use `job=afternoon`. The guide now says to inspect each failure in a red delivery run rather than assuming Reddit alone failed.
